import pytest


# Assuming the function lives in a module named `my_module`
from my_module import camel_to_snake


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Happy path
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_simple_camel_case():
    """Basic conversion with a single boundary."""
    assert camel_to_snake("camelCase") == "camel_case"


def test_multiple_boundaries():
    """String with several lowercase-to-uppercase transitions."""
    assert camel_to_snake("thisIsACamelCaseString") == "this_is_a_camel_case_string"


def test_starts_with_uppercase():
    """Leading uppercase letter followed by lowercase."""
    assert camel_to_snake("CamelCase") == "camel_case"


def test_single_lowercase_word_unchanged():
    """A plain lowercase word has no boundaries to split."""
    assert camel_to_snake("word") == "word"


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Edge cases
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_empty_string():
    assert camel_to_snake("") == ""


def test_single_lowercase_character():
    assert camel_to_snake("a") == "a"


def test_single_uppercase_character():
    assert camel_to_snake("Z") == "z"


def test_already_snake_case():
    """Underscores and lowercase letters are preserved as-is."""
    assert camel_to_snake("already_snake") == "already_snake"


def test_all_uppercase_no_boundaries():
    """Consecutive capitals have no lowercase-before-uppercase boundary."""
    assert camel_to_snake("HTTPServer") == "httpserver"
    assert camel_to_snake("UPPERCASE") == "uppercase"


def test_acronym_in_middle():
    """
    A run of capitals inside a word only splits at the last capital
    if the following letter is lowercase.
    """
    # X M L H t t p R e q u e s t  → boundary between p (lower) and R (upper)
    assert camel_to_snake("XMLHttpRequest") == "xml_http_request"


def test_acronym_at_end():
    # ... t H T M L → boundary between t (lower) and H (upper)
    assert camel_to_snake("myHTML") == "my_html"
    assert camel_to_snake("requestHTML") == "request_html"


def test_leading_acronym_followed_by_word():
    # H T T P S e r v e r → no lowercase-before-uppercase boundary
    assert camel_to_snake("HTTPServer") == "httpserver"


def test_numbers():
    """Digits break the [a-z][A-Z] pattern and act as neutral characters."""
    assert camel_to_snake("camelCase123") == "camel_case123"
    # version2String: 2 is not uppercase, so no split before String
    assert camel_to_snake("version2String") == "version2string"
    # get2HTTPResponse: no lowercase→uppercase boundary anywhere
    assert camel_to_snake("get2HTTPResponse") == "get2httpresponse"


def test_mixed_with_existing_underscores():
    """Existing underscores are preserved and everything is lowercased."""
    assert camel_to_snake("camel_Case") == "camel_case"
    assert camel_to_snake("already__Mixed") == "already__mixed"


def test_trailing_uppercase():
    """An uppercase at the very end is preceded by lowercase → boundary."""
    assert camel_to_snake("camelCasE") == "camel_cas_e"


def test_unicode_characters():
    """
    The regex ranges [a-z] and [A-Z] are ASCII-only, so non-ASCII letters
    are treated as neutral characters.
    """
    # ü is not in [a-z]; ß is not in [A-Z]
    assert camel_to_snake("überMaß") == "über_maß"


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Error cases
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_none_raises_type_error():
    """Passing None makes `re.sub` raise TypeError."""
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        camel_to_snake(None)


def test_integer_raises_type_error():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        camel_to_snake(123)


def test_list_raises_type_error():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        camel_to_snake(["camelCase"])
